motivation: v1 crossed its preregistered 30-episode directional read with positive direction; v2 is frozen only after that observation and therefore uses entirely later episodes as a replication sample.

rule.outcome: at least one winning Lightning event in the next 7 chronological rounds

frozenNull.source: same pre-v1 frozen null family; no null is re-estimated from v2 outcomes

inference.primaryTest: one-sided exact binomial test P[X>=observedSuccesses] under p0=0.384823
inference.supportingCriterion: Wilson 95% lower bound must exceed primaryProbability
inference.directionCriterion: successRate must exceed both frozen null probabilities
